quiet: The train leaves at eight o'clock. The journey takes about two hours. We eat on the way.
The market opens early in the morning. The fruit is always fresh. We go there every Saturday.
The museum closes on Mondays. Admission costs five euros. Children get in free.
It rained a lot yesterday. So we stayed at home. In the evening we watched a film.
This restaurant is very famous. The food tastes wonderful. We will come again next time.
The bus departs in the morning. The trip takes two hours. We will arrive before noon.
The ferry sails at nine. The crossing lasts around three hours. We have lunch on board.
The plane takes off at dawn. The flight takes roughly four hours. We will sleep on the way.
